subject: GreenWave - PO requirements, net terms, and invoice cadence
messages:
From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@greenwavehealth.com>
To: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@greenwavehealth.com, carlos.vega@greenwavehealth.com
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Purchase order / billing cadence questions for Redwood SOW

Hi Marcus,

Thanks for the SOW — GreenWave's procurement team reviewed it. A few quick items we need to confirm before we can issue a PO:

- We require a PO number on every invoice and payments on Net 45. Can you accommodate Net 45?
- Remittance address needs the mailing address + ACH details included on invoices (procurement template attached).
- Our standard cadence is monthly invoicing with 30 day payment; for multi-month commitments we sometimes do quarterly invoices. Which cadence do you support?

We're excited to move forward but need these operational details to align with our finance processes. I attached our PO template — happy to jump on a quick call if easier.

Thanks,
Elena Torres
Head of Procurement
GreenWave Health
Attachment: PO_Template_GreenWave.pdf
From: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@greenwavehealth.com>, procurement@greenwavehealth.com
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 23 Feb 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Purchase order / billing cadence questions for Redwood SOW

Hi Elena — really appreciate the clear list. Short answers below and items we should confirm: 

- PO number on invoice: yes, we can include the GreenWave PO number on every invoice.
- Net terms: our standard is Net 30 for SOWs under $100k, but for enterprise deals we can do Net 45 or Net 60 depending on contract. For this engagement we can agree to Net 45 if we include a small pricing concession tied to a 12-month committed usage.
- Invoice cadence: we support monthly and quarterly invoicing. Most customers on committed plans choose monthly for closer spend visibility.

I'll attach a sample invoice for format. If procurement needs a formal amendment to the SOW to reflect Net 45 + concession, we can prepare that. Proposed concession: 7% discount on committed capacity if GreenWave signs a 12-month commitment and issues a PO for the annual amount upfront or on quarterly schedule.

Suggested next step: procurement confirms whether Net 45 is mandatory, or if GreenWave can accept Net 30 with standard SOW language — if Net 45 is required we need written approval from my manager for the concession.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Attachment: Invoice_Sample_Mar2026.xlsx
From: procurement@greenwavehealth.com
To: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Cc: Elena Torres <elena.torres@greenwavehealth.com>, carlos.vega@greenwavehealth.com
Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Purchase order / billing cadence questions for Redwood SOW

Marcus — thanks for the prompt reply. Net 45 is a hard requirement for GreenWave; finance won't accept Net 30 for new vendors without senior approvals. The PO will be issued for the committed annual amount but processed according to our calendar (we can do quarterly invoicing).

Two operational asks:
1) Each invoice must include the PO number and remit to the address on the template.
2) For ACH, we need banking details and a completed W-9 attached to the first invoice.

Please let us know if the 7% concession is contingent on upfront payment, or if quarterly invoicing + Net 45 still qualifies.

Regards,
GreenWave Procurement
From: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: Elena Torres <elena.torres@greenwavehealth.com>, procurement@greenwavehealth.com
Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 13:27:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Purchase order / billing cadence questions for Redwood SOW

Lauren / Rishi — forwarding procurement's note. They are firm on Net 45 and need PO on every invoice + W-9/ACH info. I suggested a 7% concession for a 12-month committed plan; procurement wants to confirm whether the discount requires upfront payment or if quarterly invoicing qualifies.

Can we approve Net 45 + 7% discount on quarterly invoicing for this account? It's a strategic healthcare customer and would be a ~$320k ARR profile. If you prefer, we can offer a 5% concession for quarterly + Net 45 to reduce discounting.

Thoughts?

--
Marcus
From: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
To: marcus_lin@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 10:16:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Purchase order / billing cadence questions for Redwood SOW

Marcus — thanks for flagging. GreenWave is strategic, so I'm comfortable approving Net 45 as a billing term. Regarding the concession: approve up to 6% on the annual committed price if they sign 12 months AND agree to quarterly invoicing. Rationale: we trade a bit of margin for predictable committed revenue and the customer keeps their finance cadence.

Ask Rishi to prepare updated SOW language with: Net 45, PO required on invoices, remittance info block, and a 6% committed discount tied to a 12-month commitment and quarterly invoicing. Also include W-9 and bank remit block on the initial invoice.

Lauren Bishop
Director, Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@greenwavehealth.com>, procurement@greenwavehealth.com
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 02 Mar 2026 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Updated SOW and invoicing terms for signature

Hi Elena / Procurement team — attaching an updated SOW and an invoice template that contains the remittance block and W-9. Key points updated per our conversation:

- Payment terms: Net 45
- Discount: 6% off committed annual spend when GreenWave signs a 12-month commitment and elects quarterly invoicing
- Invoice requirements: PO number on each invoice; include remittance mailing address and ACH instructions; W-9 attached to first invoice
- Invoice cadence: quarterly (default per agreement) with option to switch to monthly with 5% discount reduction

We've also attached the PO template populated with our billing fields to reduce back-and-forth. Please review and confirm if we should route the SOW to DocuSign for signature.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
Attachment: Redwood_SOW_v3.pdf
Attachment: PO_Template_GreenWave.pdf

I'll watch for the DocuSign link and the populated PO number for invoices. Thanks for the quick turnaround.

Best,
